Needs a Chrome/Chromium binary ON THE HOST (google-chrome / chromium / chromium-browser, or a Mac .app). If none is found the route returns 501 `PDF generation unavailable - Chrome not installed` - the framework does NOT bundle a browser. On a fresh server install it via the OS package manager before relying on /pdf. A Chrome that is present but cannot render answers 501 too (see failed_renders).

Only server-rendered pages are renderable: the *.html pages in the app's ROOT directory (mustache or gotmpl SSR; `index.html` is `/pdf/`, `receipt.html` is `/pdf/receipt`). Files under static/ on the HTML/TSX stack are client-rendered shells, not PDF routes: `GET /pdf/<static page>` answers 404 like any unknown page. The path must be the page's route exactly: pass values in the query string (`/pdf/invoice?id=7`, read in the page as `{{param_id}}`); `/pdf/invoice/7` is not a route and answers 404. To print a report from a TSX app, add a root-level SSR page for it (see gotchas).
